{{short description|American basketball player (born 1996)}} {{Use American English|date=July 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=March 2021}} {{Infobox basketball biography | name = Sean McDermott | image = | position = [[Small forward]] | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 6 | weight_lb = 195 | league = [[NBA G League]] | team = Valley Suns | number = 3 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1996|11|3}} | birth_place = [[Anderson, Indiana]], U.S. | high_school = [[Pendleton Heights High School|Pendleton Heights]]
([[Pendleton, Indiana]]) | college = [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler]] (2016–2020) | draft_year = 2020 | career_start = 2020 | years1 = {{nbay|2020|full=y}} | team1 = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | years2 = [[2020–21 NBA G League season|2021]] | team2 = →[[Memphis Hustle]] | years3 = [[2021–22 NBA G League season|2021]]–[[2022–23 NBA G League season|2023]] | team3 = Memphis Hustle | years4 = 2023–2024 | team4 = [[Pallacanestro Varese|Openjobmetis Varese]] | years5 = 2024–2025 | team5 = [[Karşıyaka Basket]] | years6 = 2025 | team6 = [[Pallacanestro Trieste]] | years7 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025]]–present | team7 = [[Valley Suns]] | highlights = }} '''Sean Patrick McDermott''' (born November 3, 1996) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Valley Suns]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler Bulldogs]]. ==Early life== McDermott grew up in [[Anderson, Indiana]] and attended [[Pendleton Heights High School]]. After his basketball career at Butler, his mother ran a fitness center called "The Sports Center" where McDermott was often found playing basketball. As a senior, he averaged 16 points and 6.6 rebounds and was named an Indiana All-Star as he led the Arabians to the [[Hoosier Heritage Conference]].{{cite web|url=https://www.heraldbulletin.com/sports/local_sports/all-star-nod-a-dream-come-true-for-phs-mcdermott/article_09465706-e77b-11e4-bf72-9b723636e21b.html|title=All-Star nod a dream come true for PH's McDermott|first=George|last=Bremer|work=[[The Herald Bulletin]]|date=April 20, 2015|access-date=November 19, 2020}} McDermott committed to play college basketball at Butler over offers from [[Illinois State Redbirds men's basketball|Illinois State]], [[Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball|Indiana State]], [[New Orleans Privateers men's basketball|New Orleans]] and [[UNC Greensboro Spartans men's basketball|UNC Greensboro]].{{cite web|url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2014/05/30/sean-mcdermott-follows-kellen-dunham-to-butler/9793019/|title=Sean McDermott follows Kellen Dunham to Butler|first=Zak|last=Keefer|work=[[Indianapolis Star]]|date=May 30, 2014|access-date=November 19, 2020}} His uncle is long-time college coach, [[Linc Darner]].{{cite web | url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2020/03/03/butlers-sean-mcdermott-had-basketball-bond-his-grandfather/4933607002/ | title=The Indianapolis Star }} His other uncle, Tige Darner, scored over 1,200 points for the [[Appalachian State Mountaineers men's basketball|Appalachian St Mountaineers]].https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/tige-darner-1.html ==College career== McDermott was a member of the [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler Bulldogs]] for five seasons, redshirting as a true freshman.{{cite web |last=Woods |first=David |date=November 11, 2016 |title=After sitting out a year, Butler's Sean McDermott ready to find a role |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2016/11/11/after-sitting-out-year-butlers-sean-mcdermott-ready-find-role/93587656 |access-date=November 19, 2020 |work=[[Indianapolis Star]]}} He became a role player off the bench as a redshirt freshman and averaged 2.3 points, 1.4 rebounds and 10.7 minutes of playing time in 30 games played.{{cite web |last=Woods |first=David |date=March 12, 2019 |title=Redshirt paying off for Butler's Sean McDermott |url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/videos/sports/college/butler/2019/03/12/redshirt-paying-off-butlers-sean-mcdermott/3133321002 |access-date=November 19, 2020 |work=[[Des Moines Register]]}} He became a starter midway through the following season and finished year averaging 7.5 points and 3.9 rebounds over 31 games.{{cite web |last=Woods |first=David |date=November 8, 2018 |title=Saving Butler's Sean McDermott: 'Please don't tell him he can't play.' |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2018/11/08/butlers-sean-mcdermott-stricken-infection-knocked-out-basketball/1844542002 |access-date=November 19, 2020 |work=[[Indianapolis Star]]}} McDermott averaged 9.5 points and 3.9 rebounds in his first full season as a starter during his redshirt junior year.{{cite web |date=October 22, 2019 |title=Butler Bulldogs basketball: Sean McDermott role unclear heading into season |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2019/10/22/butler-bulldogs-basketball-sean-mcdermott-role-unclear-heading-into-season/4062095002/ |url-access=subscription |access-date=November 19, 2020 |work=[[Indianapolis Star]]}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/1424148/2019/12/03/sean-mcdermott-is-making-the-most-of-his-fifth-year-as-newly-ranked-butler-looks-to-go-dancing-again/|title=Sean McDermott is making the most of his fifth year as newly ranked Butler looks to go dancing again|first=Dustin|last=Dopirak|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=December 3, 2019|access-date=November 19, 2020}} On November 6, 2019, he scored a career-high 26 points on 10-of-11 shooting in an 80–47 win against [[2019–20 IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball team|IUPUI]].{{cite news |title=McDermott scores 26 to carry Butler over IUPUI 80-47 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401168287 |access-date=November 19, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 9, 2019}} As a redshirt senior, McDermott averaged 11.7 points and 6.3 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last=Bremer |first=George |date=March 25, 2020 |title=McDermott's unrelenting hard work creates unique basketball career |url=https://www.heraldbulletin.com/sports/mcdermotts-unrelenting-hard-work-creates-unique-basketball-career/article_12de0424-6eeb-11ea-8545-cf2831f3b7fe.html |access-date=November 19, 2020 |work=The Herald Bulletin}}{{cite web |last=Gentry |first=JoJo |date=March 24, 2020 |title=Sean McDermott prepares for pro basketball career from home |url=https://fox59.com/sports/sean-mcdermott-prepares-for-pro-basketball-career-from-home |access-date=November 19, 2020 |website=fox59.com}} ==Professional career== ===Memphis Grizzlies (2020–2021)=== After going undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]], McDermott agreed to terms on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] and signed with the team on November 24, 2020.{{cite August 25, 2021, McDermott was waived by the Grizzlies,{{cite web|title=Grizzlies acquire Jarrett Culver and Juancho Hernangomez from but was re-signed on September 23.{{cite web |last=Barnes |first=Evan |date=September 23, 2021 |title=Grizzlies finalize training camp roster, waive Carsen Edwards, Daniel Oturu |url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/nba/grizzlies/2021/09/23/memphis-grizzlies-complete-training-camp-roster-waive-carsen-edwards-daniel-oturu/5838451001 |access-date=October 24, 2023 |website=commercialappeal.com}} He was waived again on October 14.{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Ahmad Caver and Matthew Hurt|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-ahmad-caver-and-matthew-hurt-211014|website=NBA.com|date=October 14, 2021|access-date=October 15, 2021}} ===Memphis Hustle (2021–2023)=== On October 23, 2021, McDermott signed with the [[Memphis Hustle]] as an affiliate player.{{cite web|first=Corey|last=Moore|title=Memphis Hustle announce 2021-22 training camp roster|url=https://memphis.gleague.nba.com/news/memphis-hustle-announce-2021-22-training-camp-roster-211023/|website=NBA.com|date=October 23, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2021}} ===Openjobmetis Varese (2023–2024)=== On July 20, 2023, McDermott signed with [[Pallacanestro Varese|Openjobmetis Varese]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]].{{cite web|title=NUOVA FIRMA PER LA OPENJOBMETIS: ARRIVA SEAN MCDERMOTT|url=https://www.pallacanestrovarese.it/news/nuova-firma-la-openjobmetis-arriva-sean-mcdermott|website=PallacanestroVarese.it|date=July 20, 2023|access-date=July 21, 2023|language=it}}
